subtopics.name: Scattering amplitudes and on-shell methods
subtopics.scope: Structure and computation of gauge-theory and gravity scattering amplitudes at tree and loop level using on-shell techniques instead of Feynman diagrams.

subtopics.name: Conformal bootstrap and CFT data
subtopics.scope: Constraints on operator dimensions and OPE coefficients of conformal field theories in more than two dimensions from crossing symmetry, unitarity and the analytic structure of correlators.

subtopics.name: Two-dimensional CFT and modular invariance
subtopics.scope: Virasoro and extended chiral algebras, minimal and rational models, torus and boundary partition functions, and modular bootstrap constraints in two-dimensional conformal field theory.

subtopics.name: Gauge/gravity duality and holographic models
subtopics.scope: AdS/CFT computations of correlators, transport coefficients, phase structure and entanglement in strongly coupled field theories from classical bulk gravity solutions.

subtopics.name: Supersymmetric gauge dynamics and localization
subtopics.scope: Exact non-perturbative results in supersymmetric gauge theories obtained from holomorphy, Seiberg-Witten geometry, dualities, supersymmetric indices and localization of path integrals.

subtopics.name: Integrability in gauge and string theories
subtopics.scope: Integrable structures in spin chains, two-dimensional sigma models and planar N=4 super Yang-Mills and AdS strings, solved exactly with Bethe ansatz and S-matrix methods.

subtopics.name: String compactifications and flux vacua
subtopics.scope: Four-dimensional effective theories obtained from Calabi-Yau, orbifold, orientifold and flux compactifications of string theory, including spectra, moduli stabilization and vacuum structure.

subtopics.name: Generalized symmetries and quantum anomalies
subtopics.scope: Perturbative and global anomalies, anomaly matching and inflow, and higher-form and non-invertible symmetries as constraints on the dynamics and phases of quantum field theories.

subtopics.name: Topological solitons, instantons and monopoles
subtopics.scope: Classical and semiclassical properties of kinks, vortices, monopoles, skyrmions and instantons, including BPS bounds, moduli spaces, fluctuation spectra and tunneling amplitudes.

subtopics.name: Matrix models, SYK and two-dimensional gravity
subtopics.scope: Large-N matrix and vector models, Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev-type disordered models, and their relation to two-dimensional quantum gravity such as Jackiw-Teitelboim and Liouville theory.

subtopics.name: Renormalization group fixed points and critical exponents
subtopics.scope: Perturbative and non-perturbative renormalization group analysis of scalar, Yukawa and gauge field theories, their fixed points, beta functions and critical exponents.

subtopics.name: Extra dimensions and Kaluza-Klein theories
subtopics.scope: Models with flat or warped extra dimensions, their Kaluza-Klein spectra, brane-localized fields, radion stabilization and low-energy phenomenology.

subtopics.name: Finite-volume methods for hadron interactions
subtopics.scope: Relating finite-volume energy levels and matrix elements computed in lattice QCD to infinite-volume scattering amplitudes, resonance parameters and decay rates.

subtopics.name: Lattice fermions and chiral symmetry
subtopics.scope: Wilson, staggered, domain-wall and overlap discretizations of fermions on the lattice, and their doublers, chiral symmetry, index theorems and Dirac spectra.

subtopics.name: Hamiltonian and strong-coupling lattice gauge theory
subtopics.scope: Kogut-Susskind Hamiltonian formulations, strong-coupling expansions, quantum link models and low-dimensional lattice gauge theories studied with tensor networks or quantum simulation.

subtopics.name: Soft-collinear effective theory and resummation
subtopics.scope: Factorization theorems and all-order resummation of large logarithms in collider observables such as event shapes, jet rates, threshold and transverse-momentum spectra.

subtopics.name: Parton evolution and small-x QCD
subtopics.scope: Scale and energy evolution of parton distributions and high-energy scattering via DGLAP, BFKL and non-linear saturation equations.

subtopics.name: Heavy quarkonium and nonrelativistic effective theories
subtopics.scope: Spectra, decays and production of heavy-quark bound states and heavy hadrons using NRQCD, pNRQCD, heavy quark effective theory and potential models.

subtopics.name: Chiral perturbation theory and low-energy hadrons
subtopics.scope: Low-energy dynamics of pions, kaons and nucleons from chiral effective Lagrangians, unitarization and dispersive methods.

subtopics.name: Flavor physics and rare meson decays
subtopics.scope: Quark flavor transitions, CKM structure, neutral meson mixing and loop-induced or rare decays of K, D and B mesons in the Standard Model and beyond.

subtopics.name: Neutrino masses, mixing and oscillations
subtopics.scope: Origin of neutrino masses in seesaw and radiative models, lepton mixing from flavor symmetries, and neutrino oscillation phenomenology in vacuum and matter.

subtopics.name: Dark matter production and detection
subtopics.scope: Particle dark matter models, their relic abundance through freeze-out or freeze-in, and the resulting direct, indirect and collider detection rates.

subtopics.name: Baryogenesis and leptogenesis
subtopics.scope: Dynamical generation of the cosmic baryon asymmetry through out-of-equilibrium CP- and baryon-number-violating processes such as sphaleron transitions and heavy-neutrino decays.

subtopics.name: Axions and axion-like particles
subtopics.scope: The strong CP problem, QCD axion and axion-like particle models, their potentials, couplings, cosmological production and detection signatures.

subtopics.name: Extended Higgs sectors and vacuum stability
subtopics.scope: Singlet, doublet and triplet scalar extensions of the Standard Model, their spectra, couplings, unitarity and boundedness constraints, and the stability of the electroweak vacuum.

subtopics.name: Grand unification and proton decay
subtopics.scope: Unified gauge groups such as SU(5), SO(10) and E6, gauge coupling unification, symmetry-breaking chains, fermion mass relations and baryon-number-violating decays.

subtopics.name: Standard Model effective field theory
subtopics.scope: Parametrizing heavy new physics by higher-dimensional operators in SMEFT and low-energy EFT, including operator bases, matching, renormalization-group running and precision constraints.

subtopics.name: Precision QED and anomalous magnetic moments
subtopics.scope: Higher-order QED and electroweak radiative corrections to lepton magnetic moments, bound-state energy levels, and hadronic vacuum-polarization and light-by-light contributions.

subtopics.name: Thermal field theory and quark-gluon plasma
subtopics.scope: Equilibrium and near-equilibrium properties of hot gauge theories, including thermodynamics, screening, transport coefficients and particle production rates in the quark-gluon plasma.

subtopics.name: Cosmological first-order phase transitions
subtopics.scope: Thermal effective potentials, bubble nucleation, wall dynamics and the stochastic gravitational-wave spectra produced by first-order phase transitions in the early universe.

subtopics.name: Inflationary cosmology and primordial perturbations
subtopics.scope: Inflaton dynamics and model building, and the computation of scalar and tensor power spectra, spectral tilts and non-Gaussianities of primordial fluctuations.

subtopics.name: Modified gravity and cosmological dynamics
subtopics.scope: Extensions of general relativity such as f(R), scalar-tensor, Horndeski, massive and teleparallel gravity, and their cosmological background and perturbation dynamics.

subtopics.name: Exact solutions of Einstein's equations
subtopics.scope: Construction and classification of exact solutions of general relativity and Einstein-matter systems, including black holes, wormholes, gravitational waves and inhomogeneous cosmologies.

subtopics.name: Black hole perturbations and quasinormal modes
subtopics.scope: Linear perturbations of black holes and compact objects, including quasinormal-mode spectra, greybody factors, tidal Love numbers, superradiance and stability.

subtopics.name: Post-Newtonian and post-Minkowskian binary dynamics
subtopics.scope: Analytic approximations to the conservative and dissipative dynamics of gravitationally bound binaries, including Hamiltonians, radiated fluxes, self-force and effective-one-body mappings.

subtopics.name: Quantum fields in curved spacetime
subtopics.scope: Quantization of fields on curved or time-dependent backgrounds, including Hawking and Unruh effects, cosmological particle creation, renormalized stress tensors and Casimir energies.
keywords: quantum field theory in curved spacetime

subtopics.name: Loop quantum gravity and quantum cosmology
subtopics.scope: Canonical and covariant non-perturbative quantization of gravity with spin networks and spin foams, and loop or Wheeler-DeWitt quantum cosmology.

subtopics.name: Geodesics, black hole shadows and lensing
subtopics.scope: Motion of test particles and light in stationary spacetimes, including photon spheres, shadows, gravitational lensing angles and circular-orbit properties.

subtopics.name: Relativistic stars and compact objects
subtopics.scope: Structure, stability and tidal properties of neutron stars, boson stars and other self-gravitating compact objects in general relativity and alternative theories.

subtopics.name: Black hole thermodynamics and information
subtopics.scope: Thermodynamics of black holes across gravitational theories, microstate counting, and the information problem including Page curves and islands.

techniques.name: Feynman integrals in dimensional regularization
techniques.scope: Evaluating loop integrals with Feynman or Schwinger parameters, Mellin-Barnes representations, integration-by-parts reduction to master integrals and canonical differential equations, giving Laurent expansions in epsilon with polylogarithmic coefficients.

techniques.name: Renormalization and anomalous dimension computation
techniques.scope: Extracting counterterms, beta functions and anomalous dimensions at one or more loops and solving the resulting renormalization-group equations for running couplings, fixed points and critical exponents.

techniques.name: EFT matching and expansion by regions
techniques.scope: Integrating out heavy degrees of freedom by matching amplitudes or Green's functions at threshold, organized by power counting and the method of regions, to obtain Wilson coefficients and their scale dependence.

techniques.name: On-shell recursion and unitarity cuts
techniques.scope: Constructing tree and loop amplitudes from factorization and unitarity with spinor-helicity variables, BCFW recursion and generalized cuts projected onto a basis of integrals.

techniques.name: Dispersion relations and sum rules
techniques.scope: Using analyticity, crossing and unitarity to write dispersive representations and sum rules that fix low-energy constants, bound EFT couplings or relate spectral functions to observables.

techniques.name: Conformal block decomposition and inversion
techniques.scope: Expanding correlators in conformal blocks and using crossing, lightcone limits and the Lorentzian inversion formula to extract operator dimensions and OPE coefficients analytically.

techniques.name: Large-N saddle-point expansions
techniques.scope: Introducing auxiliary fields or eigenvalue densities, solving the saddle-point equations, and computing 1/N corrections from fluctuation determinants in vector, matrix and disordered models.

techniques.name: Instanton and bounce semiclassics
techniques.scope: Finding Euclidean classical solutions and computing their actions, zero modes and fluctuation determinants (for example with the Gel'fand-Yaglom method) to obtain tunneling rates and non-perturbative contributions.

techniques.name: Heat-kernel and zeta-function regularization
techniques.scope: Computing one-loop effective actions, Casimir energies, trace anomalies and functional determinants from Seeley-DeWitt coefficients and spectral zeta functions.

techniques.name: Bethe ansatz and integrable bootstrap
techniques.scope: Solving integrable models with the coordinate or algebraic Bethe ansatz, Yang-Baxter-consistent S-matrices and the thermodynamic Bethe ansatz to obtain exact spectra and free energies.

techniques.name: Supersymmetric localization and index counting
techniques.scope: Reducing supersymmetric path integrals and indices to finite-dimensional matrix or contour integrals over BPS loci, then evaluating them with residues, plethystic formulas or asymptotic expansions.

techniques.name: Group theory and anomaly cancellation
techniques.scope: Decomposing representations with branching rules, characters and Hilbert series, and imposing gauge and gravitational anomaly cancellation or matching conditions to constrain spectra and charges.

techniques.name: Holographic bulk solutions and renormalized actions
techniques.scope: Solving bulk field equations in asymptotically AdS backgrounds with the appropriate boundary conditions, then evaluating holographically renormalized on-shell actions, extremal surfaces or fluctuation spectra.

techniques.name: Bogoliubov transformations and mode quantization
techniques.scope: Solving mode equations on curved or time-dependent backgrounds and relating in and out vacua through Bogoliubov coefficients to obtain particle production, spectra and effective temperatures.

techniques.name: Black hole perturbation spectral methods
techniques.scope: Reducing linear perturbations to master radial equations and computing quasinormal frequencies, greybody factors and Love numbers with WKB, Frobenius or continued-fraction expansions, or matched hypergeometric solutions.

techniques.name: Effective potential and thermal resummation
techniques.scope: Computing Coleman-Weinberg and finite-temperature effective potentials with Matsubara sums, daisy resummation and high-temperature expansions to find minima, critical temperatures and transition strengths.

techniques.name: Boltzmann equations for cosmological relics
techniques.scope: Setting up and solving, analytically or semi-numerically, Boltzmann equations with thermally averaged rates to obtain freeze-out or freeze-in abundances, asymmetries and washout factors.

techniques.name: Cosmological perturbation theory and slow-roll
techniques.scope: Deriving gauge-invariant perturbation equations on FRW backgrounds and solving them in slow-roll or de Sitter approximations to obtain power spectra, spectral tilts and non-Gaussianity parameters.

techniques.name: Post-Newtonian and worldline EFT expansions
techniques.scope: Expanding the dynamics of gravitating bodies in v/c or G using point-particle worldline actions, separation into potential and radiation modes, and multipole radiation formulas to obtain Hamiltonians and fluxes.

techniques.name: Lattice momentum-space and finite-volume analysis
techniques.scope: Analyzing lattice actions in Brillouin-zone momentum space for dispersion relations, doublers and lattice perturbation theory, and deriving finite-volume quantization conditions and lattice sums.
